stories.title: Devils’ Hellebuyck won’t play Tuesday in Winnipeg
stories.summary: Connor Hellebuyck will attempt to explain himself when he gets to Winnipeg.

stories.title: Hellebuyck, Meier lead Devils past Maple Leafs 4-0
stories.summary: Connor Hellebuyck made 23 saves for his first shutout with New Jersey as the Devils blanked the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-0 on Sunday night.

stories.title: Toronto police identify city’s 33rd homicide victim in shooting
stories.summary: Emergency officials performed life-saving measures and transported the teenager to hospital, but he was pronounced dead after arrival.

stories.title: Toronto Pearson, Durham region ER among possible measles exposure sites
stories.summary: Known contacts in the Durham Region have been contacted by the department, but officials are issuing the warning after determining there may have been further exposures.

stories.title: McKenna gets benched, scores in latest Leafs’ loss
stories.summary: Gavin McKenna had the puck on his stick, looking to make a play in the offensive zone with the Maple Leafs already in a hole.

stories.title: Newhook, Fowler lead Canadiens over Maple Leafs
stories.summary: Alex Newhook scored twice in the first period and Jacob Fowler made 26 saves as the Montreal Canadiens topped the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-2 on Saturday.

stories.title: Daughter of WWII veteran selling ‘door poppies’ to support local Legion
stories.summary: Margot Rockett’s father served in the Air Force in the Second World War. In the last few years of his life, Rockett said he lived at the Sunnybrook Veterans Centre.

stories.title: Price, Bergeron headline 2026 Hall of Fame class
stories.summary: Carey Price spent a lot of his youth on the road and in the air.

stories.title: Unifor says it believes Stellantis sold its Brampton plant
stories.summary: In a statement released Friday, Unifor's bargaining team said it met with Stellantis to discuss reports that the plant had been sold.

stories.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions Canadian firms connected to Ryan Wedding and Iran
stories.summary: The department says it sanctioned money services businesses in British Columbia and Ontario in co-ordination with Fintrac, Canada's anti-money laundering watchdog.
